# Paul Irving & Shirley

- [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) — Mentor of — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — pupil · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day of teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, meeting her students—including the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and the imaginative [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)—and dealing with minor classroom infractions. After school, Mrs. H. B. Donnell confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with pretentious demands about her children's names, but [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) cheers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up by gifting her wild orchids. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her day with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020)_

> In a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares humorous anecdotes and student compositions from her teaching experience. The letter includes stories of classroom responses and student letters from Jacob, Annetta, Barbara, Willie, and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

> After [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) dies, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) invites [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move in at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) won't have to leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), which also allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to leave her teaching post and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). News of Anne's resignation and upcoming departure spreads among her students and friends, causing distress for [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035)_

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses in a new pale green dress and converses with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md) before leaving for [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) then walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they eat lunch and visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) in the garden. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) set out to pick early strawberries for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037)_

> [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) expresses concern to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Miss Lavendar's unusual despondency and apathy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come stay for a week during her vacation to help cheer Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) up. Meanwhile, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) bond over their shared experiences with imaginary dream-people before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

> After school finishes, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and meets his returning father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to pass a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the note to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and helps her prepare for Stephen's arrival that evening.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P42](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0042), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

> As wedding preparations for Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) continue, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) express their excitement about moving to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston). Meanwhile, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on romance with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and later stumbles upon [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) sharing an intimate moment. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to ponder her own future dreams of love.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is shocked to learn from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. She spends a grief-stricken night realizing her deep love for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and fearing for his life. At dawn, she speaks with [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md), who tells her that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) passed the crisis and will recover.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation
